'''Cleaning Probe Z02''' was a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droid]] used in [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Cy Krolo]] and his partner who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] got the droid out of the palace and then planted transmitters on the remaining droid to gather information on [[Voontara Fa'athra]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cleaning Probe Z02 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Unfinished Business" on Hutta.
